title: Pimco Weighs $14 Billion Debt Deal for Oracle Data Center
title_zh: Pimco 考虑以 140 亿美元债务收购 Oracle 数据中心
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Pacific Investment Management Co. is in talks with Bank of America Corp. to help provide roughly $14 billion of debt financing to build a massive Oracle Corp. data center in Michigan, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Carlyle enters $2.8bn deal to acquire majority of MAI Capital
title_zh: 凯雷投资 28 亿美元收购 MAI Capital 多数股权
summary: Galway Holdings, Harvest Partners, and Oak Hill Capital will exit their ownership positions.
summary_zh: Galway Holdings、Harvest Partners 和 Oak Hill Capital 将退出其所有权地位。

title: Carlyle Ups Stake in MAI Capital with Majority Acquisition
title_zh: 凯雷通过收购多数股权增持 MAI Capital 股份
summary: Private equity firm Carlyle has agreed to acquire $72.6B MAI Capital from Galway Holdings at a valuation of $2.8 billion.
summary_zh: 私募股权公司凯雷已同意以 28 亿美元的估值从戈尔韦控股公司收购价值 72.6B 美元的 MAI Capital。

title: M&A Deals Thriving in 2025: ETFs in Focus
title_zh: 2025 年并购交易蓬勃发展：ETF 成为焦点
summary: M&A deals are booming in 2025 despite fewer transactions -- megadeals, AI bets and Fed cuts may fuel ETFs like MNA, IAI, KBWB & CHAT.
summary_zh: 尽管交易量减少，但 2025 年并购交易仍将蓬勃发展——大型交易、人工智能押注和美联储降息可能会推动 MNA、IAI、KBWB 和 CHAT 等 ETF 的发展。
